dedupeResult: The complete active pull-request repository search was checked for WFMU, wfmu.org, KXLU, kxlu.com, SomaFM and somafm.com before creation and returned no existing route records. Canonical domains, normalized station names, official submission paths and route types were compared across the three candidates. The SomaFM channel addresses were consolidated into one channel-routed opportunity rather than stored as duplicate platform records.
emailVerificationLevel: SomaFM's currently accepting submission addresses were confirmed as publicly displayed and purpose-specific on its first-party Submit Music page. KXLU's current Music Director address was confirmed on its first-party Contact page but was not labelled as a digital submission route and was therefore recorded only as an observed business contact. WFMU's selected route is physical. Syntax and published purpose were checked; no SMTP, MX, catch-all or mailbox-level deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, message or submission was sent; no Bandcamp code, download link, track, MP3, physical media, artwork, EPK, biography, metadata or file was supplied; no package, letter, courier booking, postage purchase or shipment was prepared; no account or third-party hosting session was used; no CAPTCHA, honeypot, human-verification, cookie, anti-bot or platform control was handled or bypassed; no payment or donation workflow was started; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
